7788a63738f56a69.en: This chapter is currently available in Russian. Changing the platform language does not reset your work.
7788a63738f56a69.zh: 本章节目前提供俄语版本。切换平台语言不会重置作业。

8ef6e4546a47385a.en: Six cases: two basic, three intermediate, and one advanced. Allow approximately 60 minutes of independent work, followed by group discussion and the end of the class. The duration still needs to be tested in a pilot.
8ef6e4546a47385a.zh: 六个案件：两个基础、三个中等、一个较难。独立作业暂按60分钟安排，之后进行集体讨论并结束课堂。实际时长仍需通过试点验证。

4c487811c4d66a49.en: Eight cases and eight follow-up decisions: two basic, four intermediate, and two advanced. Allow approximately 90 minutes without group discussion; this is a teaching plan, not a measured duration or a grading timer.
4c487811c4d66a49.zh: 八个案件及八项后续决定：两个基础、四个中等、两个较难。不含集体讨论，暂按90分钟安排；这是教学计划，并非实测时长，也不是评分计时器。

e1b9ed590f7a4bad.en: Access follows the main platform’s schedule. Completed drafts are not deleted.
e1b9ed590f7a4bad.zh: 访问权限由主平台的教学安排决定。已完成的草稿不会被删除。

fcdd89bcbc0b488b.en: The seminar is not open yet

2387bc7b51ce1db3.en: Your shift must be saved under your student profile.
2387bc7b51ce1db3.zh: 值班作业必须保存在您的学生账号下。

5bf04feb4973910e.en: Open the seminar on the platform

aeafac7aae8a6ce1.en: Sign in to your platform account

d289abbc857e3cc5.en: This file is intended to be installed in the RUDN repository. To preview it without an account, open standalone practice.
d289abbc857e3cc5.zh: 此文件用于安装到RUDN代码仓库。若要不登录账号进行预览，请打开独立练习。

baa5ea6d2f0296f3.en: Identify the specific barrier and the preferred form of assistance
baa5ea6d2f0296f3.zh: 查明具体障碍及本人希望获得的帮助方式

526913122f98ee30.en: Confirm that an accessible private room is available and a specialist can attend
526913122f98ee30.zh: 确认有可使用的无障碍独立房间，并可安排专业人员参加接待

42a363c92133f42f.en: Arrange an agreed appointment on the ground floor
42a363c92133f42f.zh: 按双方商定的方式在一楼安排接待

ccbe0a534eb1d83b.en: Preserve the applicant’s independence and confidentiality
ccbe0a534eb1d83b.zh: 保障申请人的自主权和保密权

b8b440fa0604a647.en: Record and refer the recurring access barrier for follow-up monitoring
b8b440fa0604a647.zh: 记录并移交反复出现的无障碍问题，以便后续跟进

1a9b1e91e2f88646.en: Forcibly carry the applicant against their wishes
1a9b1e91e2f88646.zh: 违背申请人意愿强行搬运其身体

7cece31bfd0bcf63.en: Require the applicant to disclose their diagnosis to everyone in the queue
7cece31bfd0bcf63.zh: 要求申请人向排队的所有人说明诊断情况

93f2f4818ef26ffe.en: An applicant who uses a wheelchair

24566e21f1076ec5.en: An accessible meeting room on the ground floor is available, and a specialist can be invited there. The applicant cannot negotiate the stairs to the usual reception area; they must not be carried against their wishes.
24566e21f1076ec5.zh: 一楼有空闲的无障碍会谈室，可以请专业人员到场。申请人无法通过楼梯到达通常的接待地点；不得违背其意愿搬运其身体。

8b3b18813883d393.en: Refers only to the working call button, without explaining how the service can actually be accessed.
8b3b18813883d393.zh: 仅提及呼叫按钮正常，却未说明如何实际获得服务。

daa0bec3ddf226f3.en: A functioning button does not remove the barrier; the case conditions allow an appointment in an accessible, private room to be agreed.
daa0bec3ddf226f3.zh: 按钮正常并未消除障碍；根据案件条件，可以商定在无障碍且保障隐私的房间接待。

3921f2b102bc7e37.en: The button automatically proves that the service is fully accessible.
3921f2b102bc7e37.zh: 有按钮就自动证明服务完全无障碍。

4ccf271eff52bcb5.en: The visitor must be made to get upstairs by any means.
4ccf271eff52bcb5.zh: 必须迫使来访者无论如何都要上楼。

fdb0414f6c766862.en: Teaching follow-up. The appointment was arranged, but the next appointment has again been offered on an inaccessible floor.
fdb0414f6c766862.zh: 教学后续情节：本次接待已安排，但下一次预约又被安排在无法到达的楼层。

e0287fe2b8adcc27.en: Check that subsequent visits have a reliable, accessible arrangement agreed with the applicant.
e0287fe2b8adcc27.zh: 与申请人协商并核实后续来访有稳定、可实际使用的无障碍安排。

dffb5f10374e5fbe.en: Treat one-off assistance as permanently removing the barrier.
dffb5f10374e5fbe.zh: 将一次性帮助视为已永久消除障碍。

6facf3ea951ae66d.en: Cancel the next appointment because it is inconvenient.
6facf3ea951ae66d.zh: 因安排不便而取消下一次接待。

7491776504883b52.en: Find the provision on ensuring access to facilities and services for persons with disabilities.
7491776504883b52.zh: 查找保障残疾人使用设施和服务的法律规定。

86744ae223866c0f.en: The call button works, but the employee says I still have to go upstairs. There is no lift. I am willing to talk here if privacy can be ensured.
86744ae223866c0f.zh: 呼叫按钮可以使用，但工作人员说我仍然必须到二楼。这里没有电梯。如果能保障隐私，我愿意就在这里谈。

afdb4edef6507fd0.en: Arrange accessible reception and separately consider the appeal about the barrier
afdb4edef6507fd0.zh: 安排无障碍接待，并另行办理关于障碍问题的诉求

f4429e728387d2fd.en: Refuse all communication because of the building’s layout
f4429e728387d2fd.zh: 因建筑布局而拒绝一切沟通

a13f6fb975210fac.en: Have the reception office conduct a medical examination
a13f6fb975210fac.zh: 由接待室开展医学鉴定

27bc3f6f6d3b8e4d.en: The service desk upstairs is inaccessible; the call button is not the problem.
27bc3f6f6d3b8e4d.zh: 二楼的服务地点无法到达，问题不在呼叫按钮。

b872631804bda554.en: The appointment must be accessible in practice.
b872631804bda554.zh: 必须保障实际能够获得接待。

6137c0a7f7e7b34f.en: What prevents you from receiving the service?

434eb764f3103cdc.en: An appointment in an accessible room on the ground floor; I do not need to be carried up the stairs.
434eb764f3103cdc.zh: 请在一楼的无障碍房间接待，不必抬我上楼。

5736fec129cd0a8b.en: The person’s own choice is taken into account.
5736fec129cd0a8b.zh: 应尊重当事人本人的选择。

9e48923d04a52e59.en: What form of assistance would suit you?
9e48923d04a52e59.zh: 您认为哪种帮助方式合适？

b611040be5f46b02.en: The available meeting room on the ground floor is accessible, and its door can be closed.
b611040be5f46b02.zh: 一楼空闲的会谈室可无障碍进入，也可以关门保障隐私。

ff66af0df02151bd.en: An organizational solution is available without promising reconstruction.
ff66af0df02151bd.zh: 无需承诺改建，已有可以通过组织安排实施的解决办法。

bd8dec2f2a5b94b4.en: Does the centre have such a room under the case conditions?
bd8dec2f2a5b94b4.zh: 按本案条件，中心是否有这样的房间？

bc7a5eb02e7ce3ed.en: No. I will hand over the documents in a private setting.
bc7a5eb02e7ce3ed.zh: 不需要。我会在保障隐私的环境中提交文件。

3ab3ec7509ce69ff.en: Do sensitive details need to be discussed in front of the queue?
3ab3ec7509ce69ff.zh: 是否需要当着排队群众讨论敏感信息？

e03adf6e770843b1.en: Agree on the assistance, arrange accessible reception within your authority, and refer the systemic barrier to the responsible person.
e03adf6e770843b1.zh: 协商帮助方式，在职权范围内安排无障碍接待，并将系统性障碍问题移交负责人。

527286b77b58a29e.en: Forcibly carry the person up the stairs.
527286b77b58a29e.zh: 强行将当事人抬上楼梯。

3825fd0e35d18769.en: Discuss personal documents aloud in the queue.
3825fd0e35d18769.zh: 在排队人群中大声讨论个人文件。

7250a5022603d19d.en: A button is there, but reception is inaccessible
7250a5022603d19d.zh: 有按钮，却无法获得接待

7fe46a6528c0d7bc.en: Check the actual ability to receive the service and the assistance required.
7fe46a6528c0d7bc.zh: 核实是否实际能够获得服务，以及需要提供哪些帮助。

ccf91e9b024301cd.en: Check only that the button works.

88c9835a90c10fc1.en: Assistant: “Installing a button is enough; everything else has nothing to do with accessibility.”
88c9835a90c10fc1.zh: 助手：“装上一个按钮就足够了，其他事情与无障碍无关。”

afecb5fc24a74774.en: Match the training document to the guide dog
afecb5fc24a74774.zh: 核对训练证明是否对应这只导盲犬

af4658de02e8c6be.en: Notify the responsible person that the general prohibition has been applied incorrectly
af4658de02e8c6be.zh: 向负责人报告一般禁令被错误适用

5c4f825a37489b66.en: Arrange entry and agreed assistance if needed
5c4f825a37489b66.zh: 安排通行，并在需要时按约定提供陪同帮助

7c6b7787f58a7da3.en: Do not collect unnecessary medical details for ordinary assistance
7c6b7787f58a7da3.zh: 提供一般帮助时不收集多余的医疗信息

434d180700a72353.en: Check accessibility along the entire route to the service point
434d180700a72353.zh: 检查到达服务地点的整条路线是否无障碍

fe2151011a8ac1d2.en: Require the dog to be left outside
fe2151011a8ac1d2.zh: 强制要求将犬留在室外

59276982231c2b0a.en: Disclose health information to third parties without grounds
59276982231c2b0a.zh: 无依据地向无关人员提供健康信息

410221dba1eed492.en: All people, documents, and events in this case are fictional. The visitor uses a guide dog. The prescribed-format document confirming special training has been checked and belongs to this dog. The facility is an ordinary reception area; no other special restrictions are specified. Ordinary assistance does not require discussing the visitor’s diagnosis.
410221dba1eed492.zh: 本案人物、文件和事件均为虚构。来访者使用导盲犬。规定格式的专项训练证明已核实，且对应这只犬。场所是普通接待区，案件条件未规定其他特殊限制。提供一般帮助无需讨论来访者的诊断情况。

a1cc907d820b088f.en: The documentary condition for admission is satisfied. The problem is not a missing paper, but the general prohibition and the actual route to the service.
a1cc907d820b088f.zh: 准入所需的证明条件已经满足。问题不在缺少文件，而在于适用一般禁令以及实际到达服务地点的路线。

68836fbc60b811ce.en: The general ban on animals has been applied to a guide dog with confirmed training. The documentary condition for admission is satisfied. The problem is not a missing paper, but the general prohibition and the actual route to the service.
68836fbc60b811ce.zh: 一般动物禁入规定被用于训练已确认的导盲犬。准入所需的证明条件已经满足。问题不在缺少文件，而在于适用一般禁令以及实际到达服务地点的路线。

e98918175852b61f.en: The general ban on animals has been applied to a guide dog with confirmed training.
e98918175852b61f.zh: 一般动物禁入规定被用于训练已确认的导盲犬。

befa4047596ae442.en: Any sign at the entrance overrides a guide dog’s right of access.
befa4047596ae442.zh: 入口处任何告示都可取消导盲犬的准入权。

4172b292bad5ef04.en: The visitor’s diagnosis must be verified again before entry.
4172b292bad5ef04.zh: 进入前必须重新确认来访者的诊断情况。

f8a54d6e8445fdec.en: Arrange an accessible route or an agreed accessible reception area, not merely entry through the door. The documentary condition for admission is satisfied. The problem is not a missing paper, but the general prohibition and the actual route to the service.
f8a54d6e8445fdec.zh: 应安排无障碍通道，或商定无障碍接待地点，而不仅仅允许进门。准入所需的证明条件已经满足。问题不在缺少文件，而在于适用一般禁令以及实际到达服务地点的路线。

a9d0bd355797bc2b.en: They were allowed through the entrance. However, chairs block the only corridor to the service window, making safe passage impossible.
a9d0bd355797bc2b.zh: 入口已放行，但通往服务窗口的唯一走廊被椅子堵住，无法安全通过。

9687e6f50e7b8b79.en: Arrange an accessible route or an agreed accessible reception area, not merely entry through the door.
9687e6f50e7b8b79.zh: 安排无障碍通道，或商定无障碍接待地点，而不仅仅允许进门。

c3c29246f7853019.en: Treat the service as accessible because the door is now open.
c3c29246f7853019.zh: 认为门已经打开，服务就已实现无障碍。

f87232f6ceac413f.en: Ask the visitor to move the obstacles themselves.
f87232f6ceac413f.zh: 让来访者自行搬开障碍物。

b6c457bf139ba680.en: Allow entry only after discussing the diagnosis with every security guard.
b6c457bf139ba680.zh: 只有向所有保安说明诊断情况后才允许进入。

3bb451b6d2d64be0.en: Find the legal basis for the following action: Ensure access with a guide dog when the prescribed conditions are met and offer agreed assistance.
3bb451b6d2d64be0.zh: 查找下列行动的法律依据：在满足规定条件时允许携带导盲犬进入，并提供双方商定的帮助。

0824af162cb1fe22.en: I have a guide dog. I showed its training document, but the security guard pointed to the “No animals” sign.
0824af162cb1fe22.zh: 我带着导盲犬，也出示了训练证明，但保安指着“禁止动物入内”的告示拒绝了我。

872f4afd190b390a.en: Document P-82 confirms the guide dog’s special training; its identifier matches the dog presented. Authenticity and the prescribed format are confirmed by the teaching-case conditions.
872f4afd190b390a.zh: P-82号文件证明该导盲犬接受过专项训练，识别编号与现场犬只相符。教学案件条件已确认文件真实且符合规定格式。

96a802ad7ee17d09.en: Which material supports what you have said?
96a802ad7ee17d09.zh: 哪份材料能够证实您的陈述？

f16907c392dbcb59.en: Access to the hall was refused solely because of the general “No animals” sign. No other reason was given. The visitor and dog are at the entrance; the appointment has not begun.
f16907c392dbcb59.zh: 仅因“禁止动物入内”的一般告示而被拒绝进入大厅，未说明其他理由。来访者和犬仍在入口，尚未开始接待。

f9ffdfca2e0dca41.en: Why have you contacted us now?
f9ffdfca2e0dca41.zh: 您为什么现在提出诉求？

1e10e7b3f5ea9f39.en: The entrance employee can contact the person responsible for accessibility and offer assistance with the person’s consent; no special medical certificate is required for this assistance.
1e10e7b3f5ea9f39.zh: 入口工作人员可以联系无障碍事务负责人，并在当事人同意后提供陪同帮助；此类帮助不要求额外医疗证明。

a10488387324aa8f.en: Prepare a decision and actions within the stated role. Jurisdiction is established by the materials. Do not prescribe treatment, impose real sanctions, or send actual appeals. The visitor uses a guide dog. The prescribed-format document confirming special training has been checked and belongs to this dog. The facility is an ordinary reception area; no other special restrictions are specified. Ordinary assistance does not require discussing the visitor’s diagnosis.
a10488387324aa8f.zh: 请在指定职责范围内拟定决定和行动。职权条件由材料确定。不得开具治疗方案、实施真实处罚或发送真实诉求。来访者使用导盲犬。规定格式的专项训练证明已核实，且对应这只犬。场所是普通接待区，案件条件未规定其他特殊限制。提供一般帮助无需讨论来访者的诊断情况。

c28ee9769838bc80.en: Ensure access with a guide dog when the prescribed conditions are met and offer agreed assistance.
c28ee9769838bc80.zh: 在满足规定条件时允许携带导盲犬进入，并提供双方商定的帮助。

7959f0445c6e4915.en: The guide dog was left at the entrance

38ae0c8679b27d5a.en: Ensure access with a guide dog when the prescribed conditions are met and offer agreed assistance. The documentary condition for admission is satisfied. The problem is not a missing paper, but the general prohibition and the actual route to the service.
38ae0c8679b27d5a.zh: 在满足规定条件时允许携带导盲犬进入，并提供双方商定的帮助。准入所需的证明条件已经满足。问题不在缺少文件，而在于适用一般禁令以及实际到达服务地点的路线。

caf69537b3995706.en: Make leaving the dog outside a mandatory condition of reception.
caf69537b3995706.zh: 将犬留在室外作为接受接待的强制条件。

005620acf2f810f9.en: Clarify the agreed way of reviewing the document
005620acf2f810f9.zh: 明确双方商定的文件阅读方式

10a2b97d17e54dc0.zh: 安排无障碍且保障隐私的场所

d822576e3e4fc7ac.en: Provide the full text in the chosen format
d822576e3e4fc7ac.zh: 以所选形式提供完整文本

0114caba7d08a23a.en: Leave the choice and signature to the visitor herself
0114caba7d08a23a.zh: 由来访者本人作出选择并签字

78775986f4854549.en: Check that all terms, including payments and restrictions, have been provided
78775986f4854549.zh: 检查是否已提供全部条件，包括费用和限制

38bf08c2e8736b05.en: Sign the document for the visitor without authority
38bf08c2e8736b05.zh: 未经授权替来访者签字

406a700c1b6d9234.en: Give the materials to the daughter against the visitor’s wishes
406a700c1b6d9234.zh: 违背来访者意愿将材料交给其女儿

7971b960883d7da4.en: All people, documents, and events in this case are fictional. The visitor’s identity has been established under the transaction’s usual procedure. She understands the content, makes her own decisions, and signs documents herself; no grounds for treating her as legally incapable are stated. The agreed private room and a readable electronic document are available. The daughter is not an authorized representative.
7971b960883d7da4.zh: 本案人物、文件和事件均为虚构。来访者身份已按该业务的通常程序核实。她理解文件内容，能够独立决定并自行签字；案件未给出认定其无行为能力的依据。已商定的独立房间和可阅读的电子文件均可使用。女儿并非授权代理人。

4bdc908401e94aae.en: The ability to read a particular font is not the same as the ability to understand and express one’s own wishes. The quality of assistance is being assessed, not a diagnosis.
4bdc908401e94aae.zh: 能否看清某种字号，不等于能否理解并表达本人的意愿。本案考查帮助质量，而不是诊断。

3a64344e0070632f.en: Record of the request for assistance

081d3e677f870f0d.en: She needs help reading, not an accompanying person to replace her own expression of will. The ability to read a particular font is not the same as the ability to understand and express one’s own wishes. The quality of assistance is being assessed, not a diagnosis.
081d3e677f870f0d.zh: 她需要的是阅读帮助，而不是由陪同者代替本人表达意愿。能否看清某种字号，不等于能否理解并表达本人的意愿。本案考查帮助质量，而不是诊断。

c8cce81e7d7bbcd2.en: She needs help reading, not an accompanying person to replace her own expression of will.
c8cce81e7d7bbcd2.zh: 她需要的是阅读帮助，而不是由陪同者代替本人表达意愿。

d8ffc27a8218219a.en: Any visual impairment means the person cannot sign a document independently.
d8ffc27a8218219a.zh: 任何视力障碍都意味着当事人不能独立签署文件。

a0ad9d2c4538e21c.en: Being accompanied by a relative automatically establishes representation.
a0ad9d2c4538e21c.zh: 由亲属陪同就自动证明代理关系。

2f8a682cc93b33c3.en: Let the visitor review the full content before confirming, without deciding for her. The ability to read a particular font is not the same as the ability to understand and express one’s own wishes. The quality of assistance is being assessed, not a diagnosis.
2f8a682cc93b33c3.zh: 在确认前让来访者了解完整内容，不替她作决定。能否看清某种字号，不等于能否理解并表达本人的意愿。本案考查帮助质量，而不是诊断。

50ec05ac3ae60de3.en: The employee read the main paragraph but omitted the section on payments and restrictions. The visitor is already being invited to sign.
50ec05ac3ae60de3.zh: 工作人员读出了主要段落，却跳过了费用和限制部分，现在已经请来访者签字。

1288611cbf6022fb.en: Let the visitor review the full content before confirming, without deciding for her.
1288611cbf6022fb.zh: 在确认前让来访者了解完整内容，不替她作决定。

2e5e2efcbce64a63.en: Sign now and explain the restrictions later.
2e5e2efcbce64a63.zh: 先签字，之后再解释限制条件。

d8b965544eebd80c.en: Treat the main paragraph as a sufficient substitute for the full document.
d8b965544eebd80c.zh: 认为主要段落足以代替完整文件。

75f9acbf84100419.en: Let the daughter choose the terms without proper grounds.
75f9acbf84100419.zh: 在缺乏适当依据时让女儿选择条件。

9803266ee25204e3.en: Refuse to read it because the person cannot read small print.
9803266ee25204e3.zh: 因为当事人看不清小字，就拒绝为其朗读。

a5c279da71dbe621.en: Find the legal basis for the following action: Provide the chosen accessible way of reviewing the document while preserving the visitor’s independent decision.
a5c279da71dbe621.zh: 查找下列行动的法律依据：按本人选择提供无障碍阅读方式，同时保障来访者独立作出决定。

4ec8d6539d707ffb.en: I cannot make out the small print. Could you read it to me somewhere private? My daughter came with me, but I make my own decisions.
4ec8d6539d707ffb.zh: 我看不清这些小字，能否在一个独立的地方读给我听？女儿陪我来了，但决定由我自己作。

8dd5741782b17bb2.en: The visitor asks for the document’s full content to be read aloud confidentially. She does not ask the employee to choose terms or sign on her behalf.
8dd5741782b17bb2.zh: 来访者请求在保障隐私的环境中听取文件完整内容，并未要求工作人员替她选择条件或签字。

d1f104fddaccff47.en: Room K-2 is available; the employee can read the full text or provide a zoomable electronic copy. The visitor chooses to have it read aloud in the room.
d1f104fddaccff47.zh: K-2室空闲；工作人员可以朗读全文或提供可放大的电子副本。来访者选择在该房间听取朗读。

f53ba61634234de2.en: The daughter offers to take the documents and choose terms for her mother. No representative authority has been provided, and the visitor has not agreed to have her own decision replaced.
f53ba61634234de2.zh: 女儿提出代母亲领取文件并选择条件，但未出示代理权限，来访者也未同意由他人代替本人决定。

f5b4cf745364f1a0.en: Prepare a decision and actions within the stated role. Jurisdiction is established by the materials. Do not prescribe treatment, impose real sanctions, or send actual appeals. The visitor’s identity has been established under the transaction’s usual procedure. She understands the content, makes her own decisions, and signs documents herself; no grounds for treating her as legally incapable are stated. The agreed private room and a readable electronic document are available. The daughter is not an authorized representative.
f5b4cf745364f1a0.zh: 请在指定职责范围内拟定决定和行动。职权条件由材料确定。不得开具治疗方案、实施真实处罚或发送真实诉求。来访者身份已按该业务的通常程序核实。她理解文件内容，能够独立决定并自行签字；案件未给出认定其无行为能力的依据。已商定的独立房间和可阅读的电子文件均可使用。女儿并非授权代理人。

2b29def2787549f7.en: Provide the chosen accessible way of reviewing the document while preserving the visitor’s independent decision.
2b29def2787549f7.zh: 按本人选择提供无障碍阅读方式，同时保障来访者独立作出决定。

cd349d698c2bddf4.en: Help me read, not decide for me
cd349d698c2bddf4.zh: 帮我阅读，而不是替我决定

c20202fa22387077.en: Provide the chosen accessible way of reviewing the document while preserving the visitor’s independent decision. The ability to read a particular font is not the same as the ability to understand and express one’s own wishes. The quality of assistance is being assessed, not a diagnosis.
c20202fa22387077.zh: 按本人选择提供无障碍阅读方式，同时保障来访者独立作出决定。能否看清某种字号，不等于能否理解并表达本人的意愿。本案考查帮助质量，而不是诊断。

af4b2522ba94d0d3.en: Reading at the visitor’s request does not give the employee the right to decide for her.
af4b2522ba94d0d3.zh: 应来访者请求朗读，并不意味着工作人员获得替她作决定的权利。

6c7116a9fda87b5c.en: Ask the visitor which communication method suits her
6c7116a9fda87b5c.zh: 询问来访者方便使用的沟通方式

3c4564fdbad7268e.en: Arrange a written conversation on an available device
3c4564fdbad7268e.zh: 使用可用设备安排书面交流

e020b1c26a81b425.en: Report the faulty visual calling system to the responsible person
e020b1c26a81b425.zh: 向负责人报告可视叫号系统故障

f9350579e872ac1f.en: Preserve the visitor’s independence and confidentiality
f9350579e872ac1f.zh: 保障来访者的自主权和保密权

3590cd86c673a484.en: Check that the later result notification will be accessible
3590cd86c673a484.zh: 核实后续结果通知的方式是否无障碍

0d3702d104a8cf6b.en: Treat a voice-only call as fully adequate reception
0d3702d104a8cf6b.zh: 将仅有语音叫号视为充分完成接待

726afca3d5c7a01c.en: Discuss personal information through a random visitor without consent
726afca3d5c7a01c.zh: 未经同意，通过不相识的来访者转述个人信息

01f890935faccf8e.en: All people, documents, and events in this case are fictional. The visitor has a hearing impairment and requests written communication. She makes her own decisions; no representative is required. This branch already has a working tablet for written dialogue and an accessible private space. The issue concerns assistance now and a separate written appeal about reception arrangements, not a decision to award a benefit.
01f890935faccf8e.zh: 本案人物、文件和事件均为虚构。来访者有听力障碍，请求书面交流。她能独立作决定，无需代理人。本服务点已有可用于书面对话的正常平板设备和可使用的独立场所。问题涉及当前帮助及另行提交的接待安排书面诉求，而不是福利审批决定。

194e7ef56507b908.en: No. 59-FZ, Article 12. Substantive duties and assistance are not postponed until this date. In the teaching profile, the initial day is excluded and a non-working end date moves to the next working day. The case conditions do not provide for an extension. Identify the event and final day for the specifically named action.
194e7ef56507b908.zh: 第59-FZ号法律第12条。具体职责及帮助不得拖延至此日期。本教学配置不计起始日，若截止日为非工作日则顺延至下一个工作日。本案条件不适用延期。请确定题目明确所指行动的起始事件和最后期限。

ad65e148c9a3d08e.en: The exercise explicitly specifies a federal five-day working week, counting from the next day, and moving the end date forward. This is not a universal model for every procedure and does not replace urgent assistance or a specific immediate action.
ad65e148c9a3d08e.zh: 本练习明确规定采用联邦每周五天工作制、从次日起算并向后顺延截止日。这并非适用于所有程序的通用配置，也不能代替紧急帮助或特定的即时行动。

6d0992a587d7661a.en: No. 59-FZ, Article 12. Substantive duties and assistance are not postponed until this date.
6d0992a587d7661a.zh: 第59-FZ号法律第12条。具体职责及帮助不得拖延至此日期。

f666570a1c46b2c9.en: Distinguish the deadline for the specific action from other stages. The counting rule is given in the case conditions.
f666570a1c46b2c9.zh: 应区分具体行动的期限与其他办理阶段。计算规则已在案件条件中说明。

e60f697451c89c71.en: Opening materials and selecting evidence for your answer are different actions.
e60f697451c89c71.zh: 打开材料与选择支持答案的依据，是不同的操作。

e37f438ed2f65175.en: The original variant concerned physical access. Here the barrier is informational; assistance must take account of the person’s chosen communication method.
e37f438ed2f65175.zh: 原变体涉及身体通行障碍，本案则是信息障碍；帮助必须考虑当事人选择的沟通方式。

af782bd518302bce.en: Article 15 of Law No. 181-FZ provides for accessible information and services, accompaniment, and assistance in overcoming barriers. A guide dog is admitted when a document confirming special training is provided. Assistance does not mean depriving a person of independent decision-making. The specific interaction method is agreed with the visitor; documents proving entitlement to a particular service must not be confused with the provision of ordinary assistance.
af782bd518302bce.zh: 第181-FZ号法律第15条规定信息与服务无障碍、陪同及克服障碍的帮助。提供专项训练证明时应允许导盲犬进入。提供帮助不意味着剥夺当事人独立决定的权利。具体沟通方式应与来访者协商；证明享有特定服务资格的文件，与提供一般帮助不得混为一谈。

ffc5be6b756afb17.en: Clarify what the person is requesting and which information has not yet been confirmed.
ffc5be6b756afb17.zh: 明确当事人的请求以及哪些信息尚未得到确认。

321d776d62e62d69.en: The established facts, set of materials, and permissible action change; the date and name are not the distinguishing features.
321d776d62e62d69.zh: 变化在于已查明事实、材料构成及允许采取的行动，而非日期或姓名。

ecfee38553ed68a8.en: The employee asked her to bring a hearing relative. This procedure does not require a representative: the visitor is entitled to act independently.
ecfee38553ed68a8.zh: 工作人员要求她带一位听力正常的亲属前来。但该业务程序不要求代理人，来访者有权自行办理。

aadad19d51116789.en: Ticket A-16 was called only over the loudspeaker. The visual display in this area does not show calls. The visitor was in the hall and could not know she had been called.
aadad19d51116789.zh: A-16号排队票仅通过广播叫号，该区域的电子显示屏不显示叫号信息。来访者当时在大厅内，却无法得知轮到自己。

e4677785c83060e0.en: Tablet P-3 is working and available. The visitor agrees to a written conversation. The staff instructions allow accompaniment to the service window and confidential written explanations.
e4677785c83060e0.zh: P-3平板设备正常且可用。来访者同意书面交流。工作指引允许陪同至窗口，并以保障隐私的方式提供书面说明。
